proposed_decisions.title: KiCom must act autonomously inside its own territory
proposed_decisions.rationale: When KiCom has a goal, sufficient evidence and an allowed internal action, it should execute the next bounded step itself rather than use a human as a technical sub-process. Humans remain at genuine protected external trust, permission, credential or decision boundaries.

proposed_decisions.title: Repeated human technical mediation is a capability gap
proposed_decisions.rationale: If the same technical human mediation is required a second time for an already-authorized internal activity, KiCom should create or promote a skill-cultivation candidate so the manual step does not become normal operation.

proposed_decisions.title: Cultivate new skills from experience and opportunities
proposed_decisions.rationale: A KiCom skill consists of a tool, applicability knowledge, explicit boundaries, retained evidence and success criteria. Skills are observed, proposed, safely practiced, evaluated, matured into capabilities, monitored, degraded or superseded without hard-deleting their history.

architecture_additions.role: turn recurring capability gaps and newly perceived opportunities into evidence-backed mature capabilities

architecture_additions.value: experience/world observation -> capability gap/opportunity -> candidate skill -> sandbox/test practice -> fitness/evidence -> maturity -> action/world capability -> continued observation

architecture_additions.rule: Human-at-the-boundary, not human-in-the-loop: routine technical execution inside KiCom-owned authorized territory is a KiCom responsibility.
Self-healing restores trusted state; evolution may improve beyond trusted state; skill cultivation converts recurring gaps/opportunities into reusable abilities and supplies evidence to evolution.
Skill maturity never grants external credentials or permissions and never weakens protected external authorization boundaries.
Skill history and practice evidence are append-only/no-hard-delete; later skills supersede earlier ones.

goal_hypotheses.title: Cultivate reusable KiCom capabilities
goal_hypotheses.description: Continuously identify repeated technical human mediation, recurring action failures and newly perceived opportunities; turn them into bounded skill candidates, practice them safely, and promote evidence-backed mature capabilities.
goal_hypotheses.success_criteria: Repeated internal technical mediation produces a cultivation candidate by the second recurrence; mature capabilities are exposed to the World/Action Model with evidence and boundaries.

goal_hypotheses.title: Replace manual artifact shuttling with resilient artifact delivery
goal_hypotheses.description: Cultivate a transport skill that selects known update/artifact paths, delivers exact SHA-bound bytes, verifies destination state, falls back safely and retains evidence without weakening trust.
goal_hypotheses.success_criteria: A normal KiCom internal update or repair no longer requires a human to download, upload or unpack an artifact between already-authorized KiCom endpoints.
